name: Daimyo
desc: A few places offer Happy Hour from 17:00-19:00, if you are looking for some refreshment before dinner.

desc: Tasty ramen and late night hours off the streets of Oyafukodori. Cut through the park behind the police box and you're sure to find it. Yama-chan is the owner.

name: Asahiken Gyoza
desc: Pot stickers, steamed rice, miso soup and beer.

desc: Has a fabulous lunch menu, most dishes around ¥700-800. Tasty wrap tacos and other Latin-American style food is on available. On weekends, there is often live guitar music in the afternoon. In the evening the restaurant

name: RingerHut

name: Just Meat Yakiniku
desc: It is a restaurant where you can eat fresh yakiniku.

name: Hitokuchi Gyoza Taketora
desc: It is a restaurant that specializes in alcohol snacks such as Japanese gyoza dumplings and gopchang.

name: Toriko
desc: Great spot for delicious yakitori.

name: ShinShin
desc: A restaurant specializing in Japanese ramen noodles

name: Usagiyorikame
desc: It is a restaurant that sells monjayaki and okonomiyaki in Chuo Ward. Indoor smoking is available.

name: Umeyama tetpei shokudo
desc: It is a restaurant that sells Japanese home-cooked meals. You can enjoy Japanese home-cooked meals at an affordable price.

name: Menya Ishi
desc: This is a udon restaurant located around Hakata Station. It is famous for its udon and pollack udon.

name: The Craic and The Porter
desc: A beer bar for beer-lovers. Features numerous, hard-to-find American and European imports by a very interesting American expatriate. An entertaining time is guaranteed for all.

name: Off Broadway
desc: Run by a friendly American expatriate and is a favorite with navy personnel passing through the region. Serves a great hamburger, but don't expect it to come too quickly. Happy hour from 18:00-20:00 everyday.

name: Happy Cock
desc: Ignore the suggestive name; this is a popular crowded spot for locals and gaijin alike. The British expat owner is very friendly.

desc: Bar/restaurant is a great place to meet interesting locals, variety of shochus and a wide range of western style foods. Guinness is served on tap. Eclectic mix of local Fukuokans.
